title: 建表时该给金额用什么类型
goal: 能选对存金额的类型：知道浮点存不准、DECIMAL 才精确
trap: NULL 和 0、空字符串是一回事
template: CREATE TABLE prices (id INT PRIMARY KEY, amount {{0}}(10,2));
explain: DECIMAL 按十进制精确存储；FLOAT/DOUBLE 是二进制浮点，0.1 这种值存的是近似值，累加后会与预期差出小数。

title: 按总额降序列出每笔订单
goal: 把「多表连接 + 聚合 + 排序」组合成一次查询，并且排得「稳定」
trap: 同样的查询两次结果顺序一定一样
reference: SELECT o.id AS order_id, SUM(i.unit_price * i.qty) AS total FROM orders o JOIN order_items i ON i.order_id = o.id GROUP BY o.id ORDER BY total DESC, o.id ASC
alternatives: SELECT o.id AS order_id, (SELECT SUM(i.unit_price * i.qty) FROM order_items i WHERE i.order_id = o.id) AS total FROM orders o ORDER BY 2 DESC, 1 ASC
antiPatterns: SELECT o.id AS order_id, SUM(i.qty) AS total FROM orders o JOIN order_items i ON i.order_id = o.id GROUP BY o.id ORDER BY total DESC, o.id ASC
SELECT o.id AS order_id, SUM(i.unit_price * i.qty) AS total FROM orders o JOIN order_items i ON i.order_id = o.id GROUP BY o.id ORDER BY total ASC, o.id ASC
explain: 总额是「单价 × 数量」再求和。SUM(i.qty) 算的是件数；升序则把最该看的订单排到了最后。

title: 让没有订单的客户也出现在结果里
goal: 能识别 LEFT JOIN 被 WHERE 退化成 INNER JOIN，并知道条件该写在 ON 里
trap: ON 里的条件和 WHERE 里的条件是等价的
broken: SELECT c.name AS customer, COUNT(o.id) AS order_count FROM customers c LEFT JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.id WHERE o.id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY c.id, c.name
reference: SELECT c.name AS customer, COUNT(o.id) AS order_count FROM customers c LEFT JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.id GROUP BY c.id, c.name
alternatives: SELECT c.name AS customer, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders o WHERE o.customer_id = c.id) AS order_count FROM customers c
antiPatterns: SELECT c.name AS customer, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM customers c LEFT JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.id GROUP BY c.id, c.name
explain: LEFT JOIN 之后右表没匹配的行会填 NULL，用 COUNT(o.id) 能正确数出 0；WHERE o.id IS NOT NULL 会把这些行整行筛掉，等于退回 INNER JOIN。用 COUNT(*) 则会把空匹配当成 1 单。
